title: Ten Three Five Five (Built Not Blocked Writing)
style: build complete anthem, 94 bpm, satisfied ops vibe, warm pad, dry kick, deadpan vocal, ten kilobytes of real, deploy ready energy, terminal core
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ten point three kilobytes of real HTML built
Western Australia heritage no guilt
Twenty one track album A5 acknowledged
Three three six carrier signal block lodged

[Pre-Chorus]
The site is built the site is done
Not a placeholder gap not a half-run

[Chorus]
Ten thousand three fifty five bytes
Ready to deploy under the lights
One click upload or five min token regen
Standing between built and live again

[Verse 2]
Var dub dub dub pelican charters index dot HTML
WWW data readable nginx config swell
Desktop zynthio tools build folder mirror
VDS replica hands the line clearer

[Bridge]
Built is built deploy is the gap
Not a writing task it's a token wrap

[Outro]
The site is built the site is done
Waiting for the dashboard one
